input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (owner's standing ventures brief)
task: Deepen (flagship 10) open-tennis-robots: BUILDABLE HERE item 'the same guide for the feeder' (assembly guide generated from the CAD with fastener-stack checks)
errors: First CAD suite run failed FeederGeometryTest.test_mast_plate_holes_meet_posts_and_bearing: it asserted the mast plate's holes sat at the post centres, the fault this run fixed; updated to expect the core bores (12 holes).
A python edit script with five replacements aborted on its last assertion and wrote nothing; reran with the last pattern fixed.

doc_friction.issue: open-tennis-robots `buildable:` named the feeder guide as 'F.fasteners, its steps and joints', which undersold it: F.fasteners itself was wrong (duplicate standoff and tub lines, missing frame screws), so the item was a BOM audit plus a guide.

setUpModule starts both full package builds (feeder ~10 min) for any test in the module, so running one test class needs a wrapper that blanks setUpModule; a note at the top or an env var to skip the builds would save the next run the detour.

deviations.why: The brief favours new ventures and revenue; the router's Start here named a flagship item (the feeder assembly guide) and CLAUDE.md defaults to deepening flagships, so this run took the flagship.
deviations.did: Built the feeder's guide and fixed what it found.
deviations.result: Twelve fit faults and the BOM fixed in a package that a builder (or a kit seller) would otherwise have ordered parts for.

deviations.why: Several fixes (levelling feet M6, frame end-tap screws, lazy-susan nuts, 4-8 mm T-nut window) rest on stated assumptions about bought parts rather than measurements.
deviations.did: Stated each assumption in the guide, cad/README.md and the BOM notes.
deviations.result: Checks pass under those assumptions; a builder checks them against what they buy.

goal: Make the feeder's manufacturing package buildable by a stranger: a generated, checked assembly guide.
notes: Feeder package rebuilt with every sweep: exit 0, guide all pass. Collector package byte-identical. Guide tests pass. Full CAD suite, venture tests and preflight: results added in a later commit.
